diagnostics.message: Semantic linking evaluated arbitrary top-level code before activation; phase-safe planning is not architectural in this family.

good: Small compiler and excellent exact type/address projection.

bad: The checker sees the full typeof module graph.

ugly: Exact validators/schema/routes/OpenAPI require evaluating source values.
The tripwire proves link is an unowned effects phase, not activation.
Fixing that wall turns this candidate into the materialized or captured family.
